question: What does the TextWorld ACG dataset contain?
title: Generating Diverse Numbers of Diverse Keyphrases
answer_short: Two newly introduced keyphrase generation datasets: StackExchange and TextWorld ACG.
answer_rationale: The TextWorld ACG dataset is mentioned in the abstract as one of two newly introduced keyphrase generation datasets in the paper, alongside StackExchange. The abstract states: '...including two newly introduced in this work: StackExchange and TextWorld ACG.'
